turns.customer: I like number 1. How I go off Find My? The phone no dey on.

- Use any other device (phone or computer) go icloud.com/find
- Sign in with the Apple Account wey dey on the old phone
- Tap All Devices, choose the old iPhone 12
- Tap Remove This Device

Type your password for your own device only, abeg no send am to me.

Tell me when Find My don off, then I go set up the payment for iPhone 13 128GB (grade B), you add ₦330,724.
